title: Launch Conductor: Checklist & Signal Matrix for API / Console / Runtime
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Create a single operational Launch Conductor artifact that prescribes: milestone calendar, scope-lock rules, signal-to-action matrix, release-notes coordination, and cross-team go-to-market tasks for the API / Console / Runtime release train. Deliverables: 1) Conductor checklist with named owners for each gate; 2) Signal matrix (quantified thresholds + automated monitors) that maps to cut/rollback/mitigation actions; 3) Release notes owners and templates for API, Console, and Runtime; 4) Cross-team comms runway (marketing, support, docs, legal) and post-launch monitoring plan.
acceptance_criteria: Conductor checklist published in Google Doc with explicit owners and dates
Signal matrix has quantifiable thresholds (P95 latency, error rate, token cost delta, infra saturation) and automated alerts wired to PagerDuty/Slack
Release notes templates created for each product surface and a distribution schedule agreed by PM/Docs/Marketing
All dependencies (ENG/DES/SEC/OPS) have acceptance signoffs or documented mitigation plans
Runbook for first 72 hours post-launch created and reviewed by Support and SRE
checklist: Milestone calendar: code freeze, scope lock, doc freeze, release window(s)
Scope lock definition: 'feature-complete' + regression suite pass + perf SLOs met
Signal matrix: define green/amber/red buckets and ownership for each signal
Release notes: assign owners per surface (API/Console/Runtime) and consolidate into single release notes artifact
Pre-launch dry run: trigger canary, validate rollout automation and fallback paths
Comms: prepare marketing brief, blog draft, and customer-facing changelog entries
Support: create triage guide and escalation matrix; schedule office hours during first 72 hours
Post-launch: define quality metrics, daily dashboard cadence for first week
signal_matrix_summary: Core signals: API error rate (5xx rate), generation P95 latency, token cost variance, KV-cache hit ratio, dedicated capacity saturation, console UI error rate. Actions: GREEN = proceed; AMBER = hold + mitigation plan (canary rollback or throttling); RED = abort rollout and execute rollback. Thresholds drafted: 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 10m (AMBER), >1% for 5m (RED); P95 latency increase >25% over baseline (AMBER); token cost delta >15% (AMBER).

risk_mitigation: Canary windows across 3 regions with automated rollback at the service mesh layer
Fallback model variant plan for high-latency cases (documented in runtime runbook)
Budget guardrails: per-tenant token spend alarms to avoid cost overruns during rollout
Design QA: critical Console flows smoke-tested by Design + QA before scope lock
notes: We will use the 'Launch Conductor' doc as the single source of truth; link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1x-launch-conductor-placeholder
